summary.text: A mapped overland flow path crosses this parcel; Auckland Council says blocked flow paths can cause water to build up and enter homes.

The council maps shallow landslide susceptibility classes of High and Very Low, large-scale susceptibility of Low, and liquefaction vulnerability of Very Low here; its landslide ratings do not measure risk for an individual property.
No loan scenario applies to this purchase.
The property record identifies a Cross Lease title; Settled.govt.nz says this means owning a share of the freehold title with the other cross leaseholders.
The council property record gives a build-decade value of 1960.

next_steps.text: Ask the council or a drainage engineer whether the mapped overland flow path crosses this property and what the mapping means for it.
Check the council property file for geotechnical reports, or ask a geotechnical engineer for site-specific advice.
Ask your lawyer to check the flats plan against the actual buildings and the lease terms.
Ask your lawyer to obtain and review the LIM report and other property documents from the council.
